# Dennis Yu: agent setup and reusable methods

> Public instructions for setting up your own agent workspace. These files do not grant access to Dennis's private operations, install tools or wake other assistants.

## Start

- [Portable agent setup](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/blob/main/START-HERE.md): steps, starter workspace, handoff and recovery.
- [Raw setup instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/main/START-HERE.md): plain Markdown for readers that cannot extract GitHub HTML.
- [Machine index](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/blob/main/agent-setup.json): local document paths, adoption states and public guide URLs.
- [Workspace files](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/tree/main/coordination-starter): copy into your own permitted private workspace; inspect existing records first.

## Learn, execute and verify

- [Learn Do Teach and CCS](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/blob/main/docs/agent-setup/LEARN-DO-TEACH.md): evidence, practice, real work, cold replay and software limits.
- [Propagation](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/blob/main/HOW-KNOWLEDGE-PROPAGATES.md): canonical standards and generated instructions.
- [Acceptance](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/blob/main/ACCEPTANCE.md): account activation, update and observed-job receipts.
- [Install](https://localservicespotlight.com/install/): product-specific instructions; verify current account capabilities.
- [Company guide](https://dennisyu.com/how-agents-run-the-company/): operating method and reference tree.
- [Contribute](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): reviewed changes, tests and release identity.

Use the exact retrieved source revision. Available source is not Installed, Enabled, Tested, Scheduled or Observed behavior. Preserve the owner's permission boundary; mark unreadable or untested steps UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.

## Public knowledge graph

- [Public knowledge map](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/blob/main/docs/public-knowledge/README.md): how canonical methods, proof, training, Spotlight verticals, public relationships and agents connect.
- [Publishing standard](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/blob/main/docs/public-knowledge/PUBLISHING-STANDARD.md): public/private boundary, canonical fields, distribution and measurement.
- [IF/THEN recommendation layer](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/blob/main/docs/public-knowledge/IF-THEN.md): observable situation → supported action → proof → outcome.
- [Spotlight + training integration](https://github.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/blob/main/docs/public-knowledge/SPOTLIGHT-AND-TRAINING.md): one graph feeding the mothership, niche Spotlight sites, Skool, agent skills and social/video.
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dennisyu/local-service-spotlight-skills/main/docs/public-knowledge/catalog.json): public-safe starter object index for agents and crawlers.

## Browse the published knowledge

These views connect the IF/THEN Builder Journey to existing source owners. Use their canonical destinations and provenance when citing or updating a method.

- [Knowledge Library](https://dennisyu.com/knowledge/): public guides and searchable canonical destinations.
- [Source directory](https://dennisyu.com/knowledge/#sources): existing hubs for methods, tasks, training, Spotlight sites, public relationships and proof.
- [Agent entry](https://dennisyu.com/knowledge/#for-agents): source IDs, provenance and routes to maintained owners.
- [Derived knowledge catalog JSON](https://dennisyu.com/knowledge/catalog.json): the site's browse projection, preserving links to canonical sources.
- [Public video index JSON](https://dennisyu.com/knowledge/videos.json): metadata from the existing public video library; listing does not establish recording review or learner completion.
- [Public video library](https://if-then-builder-journey.local-servic-8436.chatgpt.site/library/all/): human browse view of those existing video entries.
